title: An empty `skip:` reason and a negative `retries:` count compile.
text: `#[Test(skip: "")]` passes `nvs check`, and the report prints `skipped: ` with nothing after it. `rule:testing/runner-is-strict` says a skip states a reason, and the type alone (`string`) is what holds it to that. `#[Test(retries: -1, because: "x")]` compiles too, and the test runs once with no retry. It closes when an empty `skip:` or `because:` and a `retries:` below 1 are compile errors, with a conformance case.
